title: elymus glaucus subsp. virescens
intro: Elymus glaucus subsp. virescens, commonly known as Blue Wild Rye, is a plant species native to Europe, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Elymus glaucus subsp. virescens include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate coughs and relieve pain. The bioactive constituents of Elymus glaucus subsp. virescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
